blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,适当的视觉利用能够大大地改进一般视觉语言模型在各种医学成像任务方面的性能。 我们引入了\ours,一种医疗视觉控制装置,它为一般的VLM配备了交互式视觉工具和系统的诊断证据管理. 通过\ours,一般的VLMs交互地探索医疗图像并逐渐得到诊断证据,这些证据保存在一个无损失的内存中,供后续检索和使用. 在提交初步答复后,核查组收到了对潜在遗漏和所查明结论的可靠性的评估。 这项评估指导了进一步的图像检查和测量,然后在获得充分证据之前,通过迭代代理循环对答案进行修订。 在11项任务和4个成像模式中,我们用Qune3.8-27B改进了所有任务的业绩,在脾脏测量(63.3----98.3---)、肾脏搜索(57.5-----71.2---)和肺结核检测(0.0------28.2----)方面取得了显著进展。 高能 API 基于 VLM 与\ours 实现更高性能. 例如,GPT-6.1 索尔将肺结核检测从10.8\%提高到69.2\%,与"我们"结合,展现出更强大的模型能力与有效的医疗视觉利用的互补效益. 我们的成果突出表明了视觉利用的潜力,作为将一般的VLM推广到医学成像任务的新范例。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Scaling general VLMs to medical imaging with VERA. VERA provides a medical visual harness for image exploration and diagnostic evidence management, delivering substantial performance gains across diverse VLM backbones and medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 图1:用甚高频放大一般甚高分辨率成像仪进行医学成像。 VERA为图像探测和诊断证据管理提供了医疗视觉工具,在各种VLM主干线和医疗成像任务中提供了实质性的性能收益.

blocks.en:
General vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong visual understanding, grounding, and reasoning capabilities across a wide range of tasks [ 2 , 28 , 4 , 8 ] . However, these capabilities do not consistently translate into strong performance on medical imaging tasks, a gap commonly attributed to the domain shift between natural and medical images [ 19 , 16 ] .
To bridge this gap, a major line of research has focused on developing medical VLMs through pretraining and finetuning on domain-specific data [ 19 , 21 , 25 , 24 , 16 , 13 , 34 ] . Medical AI agents offer a complementary approach, using specialized tools, interactive image exploration, or multi-agent collaboration to enhance the capabilities of VLMs in medical imaging [ 18 , 7 , 30 , 23 , 29 , 22 , 15 , 32 ] .
These efforts largely emphasize domain specialization, either in the VLMs themselves or in the systems built around them. Could general VLMs already possess substantial capabilities for medical imaging that remain untapped?
blocks.zh:
一般视觉语言模型(VLMs)在一系列广泛的任务中表现出了强烈的视觉理解,地基和推理能力[2,28,4,8]. 然而,这些能力并非始终如一地转化为医学成像任务的有力表现,这种差距通常归因于自然图像与医学成像之间的域位变化[19,16].
为弥补这一差距,一项主要研究的重点是通过对特定领域数据进行预先培训和微调来发展医学的VLM[19、21、25、24、16、13、34]。 医疗人工智能代理商提供一种补充方法,使用专门工具,交互式图像探索,或多代理协作,以提高VLM在医疗成像方面的能力[18,7,30,23,29,22,15,32].
这些努力主要强调领域专门化,无论是在VLM本身还是在围绕它们建立的系统中。 普通的甚高频是否已经具备大量尚未开发的医疗成像能力?

blocks.en: We posit that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general VLMs on medical images by making more effective use of their existing capabilities. A visual harness provides an inference-time interaction mechanism between the model and visual data, organizing how the model accesses, inspects, retrieves, and utilizes visual information throughout the reasoning process. Recent work such as VISTA [ 10 ] has demonstrated the potential of this paradigm by equipping VLMs with lossless visual memory and tools for active inspection and retrieval, improving their performance in interactive visual environments. However, in medical imaging, visual observations do not necessarily constitute sufficient diagnostic evidence. A medical visual harness should extend beyond managing visual observations to organizing the acquisition and verification of diagnostic evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,适当的视觉利用能够更有效地利用现有能力,大大改善医疗图像上一般甚高分辨率材料的性能。 视觉牵引机提供了模型和视觉数据之间的推论时间交互机制,组织模型在整个推理过程中如何访问,检查,检索和利用视觉信息. 最近的工作,如VISTA[10],通过为VLMs配备无损失的视觉内存和主动检查和检索工具,提高它们在交互式视觉环境中的性能,证明了这种范式的潜力. 然而,在医学成像中,视觉观察并不一定构成充分的诊断证据. 医疗视觉手段应超越对视觉观察的管理,扩大到组织获取和核实诊断证据。

blocks.en: Effective management of diagnostic evidence involves three complementary aspects: evidence acquisition, preservation, and assessment. First, radiologists acquire evidence through iterative visual inspection, adjusting image magnification, reviewing contiguous slices, examining multiplanar views, and obtaining quantitative measurements [ 27 , 14 ] . A medical visual harness should equip VLMs with similar capabilities. Second, diagnostic evidence is accumulated progressively, with previously acquired evidence often revisited for comparison and subsequent assessment. Therefore, all acquired evidence should be preserved losslessly and remain accessible throughout the reading process. Third, lesions may remain undetected in unexamined regions or in regions inspected at insufficient resolution [ 3 , 5 ] . The reliability of identified findings, in turn, is influenced by the level of detail in visual inspection, the viewing perspectives, and the availability of quantitative measurements. A medical visual harness should assess potential omissions and finding reliability to inform further inspection or establish the sufficiency of available evidence.
blocks.zh: 对诊断证据的有效管理涉及三个相辅相成的方面:证据的获取、保存和评估。 首先,放射学家通过迭代视觉检查,调整图像放大,审查毗连片,检查多行星观测,获得定量测量结果[27,14],获取证据. 医疗视控装置应使甚高频具有类似能力。 第二,诊断证据逐步积累,以前获得的证据经常重新加以比较和随后的评估。 因此,所有获得的证据都应毫无损失地保存,并在整个阅读过程中保持可获取性。 第三,在未经审查的区域或被检查的决议不充分的区域,损害可能仍未被发现。 所查明结论的可靠性反过来又受到视觉检查的详细程度、观察观点和数量测量的可用性的影响。 医疗视觉手段应评估可能的遗漏,并找出可靠性,以便进一步检查或确定现有证据是否充分。

blocks.en: To address these requirements, we introduce Visual Evidence Reasoning Architecture (VERA), a medical visual harness for general VLMs. VERA consists of five components: Medical Visual Tools, Lossless Evidence Memory, Evidence Map, Evidence Verifier, and an Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop. The VLM uses visual tools to explore medical images and obtain quantitative measurements, while the memory preserves acquired evidence and the Evidence Map tracks the inspected regions and potential omissions. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives feedback from the Evidence Map on remaining search regions and from the Evidence Verifier on the reliability of identified findings. This feedback guides further inspection, measurement, and answer revision through the Agentic Loop.
blocks.zh: 为满足这些要求,我们引入了视觉证据理性建筑(VERA),这是用于普通甚高分辨率LM的医学视觉装置. VERA由五个部分组成:医疗视觉工具,无损失证据记忆,证据地图,证据验证器,以及一个证据指导代理循环. VLM使用视觉工具来探索医学影像并获得定量测量,而内存则保存了获得的证据,证据地图跟踪了被检查地区和潜在的遗漏. 在提交初步答复后,核查组从证据地图收到关于剩余搜索区域的反馈,从证据核实员收到关于已查明调查结果的可靠性的反馈。 这种反馈指导通过 " 代理环 " 进行进一步检查、衡量和答复修订。

blocks.en: We evaluate VERA on 11 tasks spanning four medical imaging modalities. With Qwen3.8-27B, VERA improves over direct image input on all 11 tasks and achieves best or tied-best performance among agent baselines on 10 tasks. Spleen measurement accuracy rises from 63.3% to 98.3%, and pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity from 0.0% to 28.2%. Across five additional backbones, VERA improves all four task categories, with stronger models achieving higher absolute performance on multiple tasks. Pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity reaches 60.0% with Claude Opus 5.5 and 69.2% with GPT-6.1 Sol, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger VLMs and an effective visual harnesses. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of visual harnesses for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价VERA的11项任务,涉及四种医学成像模式。 通过Quen3.8-27B,VERA改进了所有11项任务的直接图像输入,并在10项任务的代理基线中实现了最佳或捆绑的最佳性能. 脾脏测量精度从63.3%提高到98.3%,肺结核检测灵敏度从0.0 %提高到28.2%. 通过另外五个主干,VERA改进了所有四个任务类别,更强大的模式在多个任务上实现了更高的绝对性能. 肺结核检测灵敏度达到60.0%,克劳德·奥普斯为5.5,GPT-6.1 Sol为69.2%,显示了更强的VLM和有效视觉带的互补效益. 总体而言,我们的调查结果突出了视觉利用的潜力,将一般的甚低分辨率放大到医疗成像任务。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗远景-语言模型

blocks.en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) have been developed by adapting general multimodal architectures to medical image–text data and tasks. Early systems such as LLaVA-Med and Med-Flamingo use biomedical image–text instruction data or continued pretraining to support medical visual question answering and related tasks [ 19 , 21 ] . Recent models have expanded their capabilities across imaging modalities, spatial dimensions, and clinical tasks. MedGemma provides medical-adapted multimodal models at different scales, with MedGemma 1.5 further extending support to volumetric CT and MRI, whole-slide pathology, and anatomical localization [ 25 , 24 ] . Lingshu-32B is a generalist medical VLM designed for unified understanding across more than a dozen medical imaging modalities, including CT, MRI, ultrasound, and histopathology [ 16 ] . Hulu-Med extends medical visual understanding to 2D images, 3D volumes, and video through a unified vision encoder and large-scale multimodal training [ 13 ] . ClinFusion adopts a vision-centric architecture with cascaded spatial-aware feature fusion to support both 2D and native 3D medical image understanding [ 34 ] . Unlike specialized medical VLMs, VERA enhances general VLMs through interactive visual tools and diagnostic evidence management.
blocks.zh: 医疗视觉语言模型(VLMs)是通过使一般的多式联运结构适应医疗图像-文本数据和任务而开发的。 LLaVA-Med和Med-Flamingo等早期系统使用生物医学图像-文本指导数据或继续预训,以支持医疗视觉问题的回答和相关任务[19,21]. 最近的模型在成像模式、空间维度和临床任务中扩大了能力。 MedGemma提供不同尺度的医学适应型多式联运模型,其中MedGemma 1.5进一步扩展了对体积CT和核磁共振的支持,全滑体病理,解剖定位[25,24]. Lingshu-32B是一种通论医学VLM,旨在统一理解十多种医学成像模式,包括CT,核磁共振,超声波,以及组织病理学[16]. Hulu-Med通过统一的视觉编码器和大规模多式联运培训,将医疗视觉理解扩展到2D图像,3D卷,以及视频. [13]. ClinFusion采用了以视觉为中心的结构,带有级联的空间感知特征聚变,以支持2D和本土的3D医疗图像理解[34]. 与专业医学VLM不同,VERA通过交互式视觉工具和诊断证据管理增强一般VLM.

blocks.en: 2.2 Medical AI Agents
blocks.zh: 2.2 医疗助理人员

blocks.en: Medical AI agents extend foundation models with tools, task decomposition, or collaboration among multiple agents. MDAgents adapts the collaboration structure of language-model agents to the complexity of medical decision-making tasks [ 15 ] . 3DMedAgent coordinates visual and textual tools to support multi-step analysis of volumetric CT, combining perception modules with an agent that moves between global and local views [ 29 ] . Visual tool-use approaches such as VLM-R 3 , DeepEyes also let multimodal models select image regions or request additional visual observations during reasoning [ 12 , 35 ] . VERA extends this capability by explicitly assessing the diagnostic evidence acquired during these interactions, including the coverage of image inspection and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further inspection and finding verification within Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop.
blocks.zh: 医疗AI剂以工具,任务分解,或多种剂之间的协作来扩展基础模型. MDAgents将语言模型代理的合作结构适应医疗决策任务的复杂性[15]. 3DMedAgent协调视觉和文字工具,支持对音量CT的多步骤分析,将感知模块与在全局和本地视角之间移动的代理结合[29]. VLM-R 3,DeepEyes等视觉工具使用方法也让多式联运模型在推理过程中选择图像区域或请求额外的视觉观察[12,35]. VERA通过明确评估这些相互作用期间获得的诊断证据,包括图像检查的覆盖面和已查明结果的可靠性,来扩展这种能力。 这项评估指导了证据指导代理圈内的进一步检查和核查。

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual Harnesses
blocks.zh: 2.3 视觉机理

blocks.en:
The capabilities of an LLM depend not only on the model itself but also on the system that supports its interaction with external tools and the environment. An LLM harness provides this support by managing tool execution, memory, and task progression. ReAct [ 33 ] established a widely adopted reasoning–acting loop in which the model alternates between reasoning, tool execution, and observation. Recently, VISTA [ 10 ] extends this paradigm to visual tasks by combining active image inspection with lossless visual memory, demonstrating the benefits of organizing visual interaction around frozen VLMs. However, medical imaging tasks require more than visual observation: diagnostic evidence is progressively acquired, preserved, and verified before a diagnostic conclusion is reached. VERA extends the visual harness paradigm from managing visual observations to managing diagnostic evidence throughout the
interpretation process. VERA introduces evidence-guided verification into the agentic loop, using the assessment of acquired evidence to guide subsequent model actions.
blocks.zh:
LLM的能力不仅取决于模型本身,还取决于支持其与外部工具和环境互动的系统. 通过管理工具执行、内存和任务进度,LLM管理器提供这种支持。 ReAct [33] 建立了一个被广泛采纳的推理-行为循环,其中模型替代介于推理,工具执行和观察之间. 最近,VISTA[10]将这个范式扩展至视觉任务,将主动的图像检查与无损失的视觉内存结合起来,展示围绕冷冻的VLM组织视觉交互的好处. 然而,医学成像任务需要的不仅仅是视觉观察:诊断证据在得出诊断结论前是逐步获得,保存和核实的. VERA将视觉利用范式从管理视觉观察扩展到管理诊断证据,贯穿整个过程。
解释过程。 VERA将证据指导核查引入代理循环,利用对所获取证据的评估来指导随后的示范行动.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: We introduce VERA, a medical visual harness that enables general VLMs to acquire, retain, and assess diagnostic evidence for medical imaging tasks. As illustrated in Figure 2 , VERA consists of five components: Medical Visual Tools, Lossless Evidence Memory, Evidence Map, Evidence Verifier, and Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了VERA,一种医学视觉工具,它使普通的VLM能够获取,保留,并评估医疗成像任务的诊断证据. 如图2所示,VERA由五个部分组成: 医疗视觉工具、无损失证据记忆、证据地图、证据验证器和证据指导代理循环。

blocks.en: The VLM explores the image using Medical Visual Tools for navigation, multi-view inspection, and quantitative measurement ( Section 3.2 ), while Lossless Evidence Memory preserves acquired images and measurements ( Section 3.3 ). The Evidence Map tracks inspection coverage ( Section 3.4 ). After an initial answer, the Evidence Map identifies regions requiring further inspection, and the Evidence Verifier assesses findings and alternatives ( Section 3.5 ). Their feedback guides further inspection, measurement, and answer revision in the Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop ( Section 3.6 ) until the checks pass or the interaction budget is exhausted.
blocks.zh: VLM利用医疗视觉工具对图像进行导航、多视图检查和定量测量(第3.2节),而无损失证据记忆则保存获得的图像和测量(第3.3节)。 证据地图追踪检查范围(第3.4节)。 在初步答复之后,证据地图确定了需要进一步检查的区域,证据核实者评估了调查结果和替代办法(第3.5节)。 他们的反馈指导进一步检查、衡量和答复修订证据指导代理环(第3.6节),直至检查合格或互动预算用完为止。

blocks.en: 3.2 Medical Visual Tools
blocks.zh: 3.2 医疗视觉工具

blocks.en: Medical images contain findings across different locations, scales, and views. A single rendered image may not capture small findings or reveal the spatial relationships of anatomical structures. VERA provides visual tools that allow the VLM to navigate medical images, adjust magnification, inspect local regions, and examine structures from multiple views. The view tool supports slice and region inspection with adjustable viewing parameters, while montage and scan enable examination of multiple slices or image regions. For volumetric images, triplanar provides axial, coronal, and sagittal views of the same location.
blocks.zh: 医疗图像包含不同地点、尺度和观点的发现。 单一成像可能无法捕捉小发现或揭示解剖结构的空间关系. VERA提供视觉工具,使VLM能够导航医疗图像,调整放大,检查局部区域,并从多个角度检查结构. 视图工具支持使用可调整的视图参数进行切片和区域检查,而蒙太奇和扫描则允许对多个切片或图像区域进行检查. 对于量子图像,triplanar提供轴,冠,和同一位置的斜视.

blocks.en: Visual inspection alone also provides limited access to quantitative properties of medical images. VERA therefore provides measurement tools that extract quantitative information directly from the image data. The read_hu and read_intensity tools return intensity statistics for selected regions, while measure and read_shape provide physical measurements and geometric descriptors of identified structures. Modality-specific tools further support measurements such as cavity dimensions and volume in ultrasound. These tools allow the VLM to combine visual observations with quantitative measurements when assessing medical findings.
blocks.zh: 光是视觉检查也可以有限地获得医疗图像的数量特性。 因此,VERA提供了直接从图像数据中提取定量信息的测量工具. 读_hu和读_强度工具返回选定区域的强度统计,同时测量和读_形状提供已识别结构的物理测量和几何描述符. 特异性工具进一步支持超声波中的腔尺寸和体积等测量. 这些工具使得VLM在评估医学结论时可以将视觉观测和定量测量结合起来.

blocks.en: 3.3 Lossless Evidence Memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 无损失的证据内存

blocks.en: Diagnostic evidence accumulates through successive interactions with the Medical Visual Tools. The VLM combines observations across views and scales, compares candidate findings, and revisits earlier measurements to verify its conclusions. These operations require access to the original images and measurement results. The finite context window limits the evidence retained in the conversation, while text summaries may omit visual details and numerical information. VERA therefore maintains a lossless memory outside the active context, preserving acquired evidence for subsequent retrieval and assessment.
blocks.zh: 诊断证据通过与医学视觉工具的连续互动而积累. 自愿核查活动综合了各种意见和尺度的意见,比较了候选调查结果,并重新审视了早先的衡量方法,以核实其结论。 这些操作需要访问原始图像和测量结果。 有限的上下文窗口限制对话中保留的证据,而文本摘要可能会省略视觉细节和数字信息. 因此,VERA在活动上下文之外保持一种无损失的内存,保留获得的证据,供随后检索和评估。

blocks.en: Each image presented to the VLM is saved with its location and viewing parameters. Each measurement result is stored verbatim with the tool name and arguments used to obtain it. Images and measurements receive unique identifiers. The history tool lists the stored records, and recall retrieves selected images and measurement results by identifier. Multiple images can be retrieved together for cross-view comparison, and previous measurements can be consulted during candidate verification and answer revision.
blocks.zh: 提交VLM的每个图像都以其位置和查看参数保存. 每个测量结果都与用来获得它的工具名称和参数一起逐字存储. 图像和测量得到独特的标识。 历史工具列出存储的记录,并回忆通过标识符检索到选定的图像和测量结果. 多个图像可以一起检索进行交叉视图比较,在候选验证和回答修正时可以参考以前的测量.

blocks.en: The memory also retains working notes, findings, and the current answer across context resets. The VLM uses note to record intermediate conclusions, evidence references, and pending checks. Before a reset, it generates a handoff summary of its progress and remaining tasks. The new context includes this summary, working notes, findings, and recent images. Earlier images and measurements remain accessible through recall for subsequent verification and answer revision.
blocks.zh: 内存还保留了工作说明,发现,以及当前对上下文的回答. 核查清单使用说明记录中间结论、证据参考和待核对。 在重置前,它生成一份其进展和剩余任务的交接摘要. 新的背景包括这一摘要、工作说明、调查结果和最新图像。 早期的图像和测量仍可通过召回进行后续核查和答复修订。

blocks.en: 3.4 Evidence Map
blocks.zh: 3.4 证据地图

blocks.en: Medical images often contain small and sparsely distributed findings across large spatial regions. Examining a region does not necessarily rule out missed findings, as the resolution of an acquired view determines the level of detail available for inspection. A binary record of visited and unvisited regions is therefore insufficient to characterize the progress of image inspection. The Evidence Map addresses this problem by maintaining a spatial representation of the inspected image and estimating the findings that may remain undetected in each region.
blocks.zh: 医疗图像往往含有在大空间区域分布稀少的少量调查结果。 检查某一区域不一定排除错失的发现,因为获得的意见的解决决定了可供检查的详细程度。 因此,访问和未访问地区的二进制记录不足以说明图像检查的进展情况。 证据地图通过保持所检查图像的空间代表性和估计每个区域可能仍未发现的调查结果来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: Given a target region, the Evidence Map partitions it into spatial cells and assigns each cell an initial estimate of potentially undetected findings based on its size and a prior finding rate. Let 𝒞 \mathcal{C} denote the set of cells, V c V_{c} the size of cell c c , and λ \lambda the expected finding rate per unit of the image domain. The initial residual estimate is m c ( 0 ) = λ ​ V c , m_{c}^{(0)}=\lambda V_{c}, (1) where m c m_{c} represents the expected number of findings that may remain undetected in cell c c .

Let f c , t f_{c,t} denote the fraction of cell c c covered by observation t t , and q ⁡ ( r t ) q(r_{t}) the detection weight associated with its viewing resolution r t r_{t} . blocks.en: The Evidence Map updates these estimates throughout image inspection without directing the initial search. After the VLM submits its initial answer, the accumulated residual estimate is evaluated against a predefined tolerance. If the estimated number of potentially undetected findings remains above the tolerance, the Evidence Map identifies regions for further inspection.
blocks.zh: " 证据地图 " 在整个图像检查过程中更新了这些估计数,但没有指导初步搜索。 在VLM提交初步答复后,根据预先确定的耐受性对累积的剩余估计数进行评估。 如果可能未发现的调查结果的估计数量仍然高于容忍度,证据地图将确定需要进一步检查的区域。

blocks.en: 3.5 Evidence Verifier
blocks.zh: 3.5 证据验证人

blocks.en: Visual similarity alone may not be sufficient to distinguish a pathological finding from a normal anatomical structure. For example, a vessel viewed in cross-section may resemble a pulmonary nodule in an axial CT slice. Reliable assessment therefore requires examining suspected findings in greater detail and considering additional visual and quantitative evidence. Moreover, judgments based on different levels of inspection provide different degrees of confidence. The Evidence Verifier addresses these issues by maintaining a belief for each candidate finding and updating it according to the evidence acquired during inspection.
blocks.zh: 光是视觉相似性可能不足以区分病理发现和正常解剖结构. 例如,横截面观察的容器可能类似于轴心CT片中的肺结核。 因此,可靠的评估需要更详细地审查可疑的调查结果,并考虑更多的视觉和定量证据。 此外,基于不同程度检查的判决提供了不同程度的信心。 证据核实员通过保持每个候选人的信念,并根据在检查期间获得的证据予以更新,来处理这些问题。

blocks.en: After the initial answer is submitted, the VLM registers the finding addressed by its answer, together with other observed structures that could be confused with it. Each candidate is assigned an identifier and associated with its spatial location and quantitative readouts. The register tool extracts local image characteristics around the candidate, providing measurements for candidate comparison. The VLM then examines each candidate and records its verdict and confidence. This allows the system to assess the reported finding against other plausible findings.
blocks.zh: 在提交初步答复后,自愿多数派记录了通过答复处理的调查结果,以及可能与之混淆的其他观察结构。 每个候选人都被分配到一个标识符,并与其空间位置和定量读出有关。 寄存器工具提取候选人周围的本地图像特征,为候选人比较提供测量. 然后,村代表大会审查每个候选人,并记录其判决和信心。 这使该系统能够对照其他可信的调查结果评估所报告的调查结果。

blocks.en: For candidate j j , let C j C_{j} denote the candidate and p j ( t ) p_{j}^{(t)} its current probability of being the target finding. Each candidate is initialized with a prior probability p j ( 0 ) p_{j}^{(0)} , determined by the task and the source of the candidate. The Evidence Verifier updates this probability using the VLM’s judgment, with confidence s j s_{j} and inspection reliability ρ j \rho_{j} taken into account. The corresponding likelihood ratio is defined as: LR ⁡ ( s j , ρ j ) = ρ j ​ s j + ( 1 − ρ j ) / 2 ρ j ​ ( 1 − s j ) + ( 1 − ρ j ) / 2 . \operatorname{LR}(s_{j},\rho_{j})=\frac{\rho_{j}s_{j}+(1-\rho_{j})/2}{\rho_{j}(1-s_{j})+(1-\rho_{j})/2}. (5) The reliability ρ j \rho_{j} reflects the thoroughness of inspection and determines the weight assigned to each verdict. The Evidence Verifier updates candidate probabilities, allowing findings to be compared and uncertain cases to be identified.

blocks.en: In addition to candidate verification, the Evidence Verifier checks that numerical values reported in the answer are linked to the corresponding measurement tool outputs. Since candidate-registration readouts may include surrounding tissue, reported dimensions and volumes are obtained through separate measurements of the finding itself.
blocks.zh: 除了候选人核查外,证据核查员还核查答复中报告的数值是否与相应的计量工具产出相联系。 由于候选人登记读出可能包括周围组织,因此报告尺寸和体积是通过对发现本身的单独测量得到的。

blocks.en: 3.6 Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop
blocks.zh: 3.6 证据指导代理循环

blocks.en: In conventional tool-calling loops, VLMs select tools based on their current observations and continue interacting with the image until they produce an answer. However, the model’s decision to finish does not necessarily indicate sufficient image inspection or reliable finding identification. VERA therefore introduces an evidence-guided verification stage into the agentic loop, using the Evidence Map and Evidence Verifier to assess the model’s initial answer and guide subsequent actions.
blocks.zh: 在传统的工具调用循环中,VLM根据当前观测结果选择工具,并继续与图像互动,直到生成答案. 然而,模型完成的决定并不一定表明有足够的图像检查或可靠的识别。 因此,VERA将证据指导核查阶段引入代理循环,使用证据地图和证据验证器评估模型的初步答案并指导随后的行动。

blocks.en: The loop begins with autonomous image inspection. The VLM uses the Medical Visual Tools to explore the image and acquire measurements, while the Lossless Evidence Memory preserves the acquired evidence and the Evidence Map continuously updates the status of inspected regions. The initial exploration is not guided by coverage feedback, allowing the VLM to form its own assessment. Once the VLM submits an initial answer, the verification stage begins. The Evidence Verifier evaluates the reported findings and their plausible alternatives, while the Evidence Map assesses the remaining search coverage and identifies regions requiring further inspection.
blocks.zh: 循环从自主图像检查开始. VLM使用医学视觉工具来探索图像并获取测量数据,而无损失证据记忆则保存了获得的证据,证据地图不断更新被检查地区的状况. 最初的探索没有以覆盖反馈为指导,使得VLM能够形成自己的评估. 一旦核查清单提交初步答复,核查阶段便开始。 证据核实员对所报告的调查结果及其可行的替代办法进行评价,而证据地图则对剩余的搜索范围进行评估,并确定需要进一步检查的区域。

blocks.en: The resulting feedback is returned to the VLM, which performs additional inspection or measurement and revises its answer as needed. Each subsequent submission triggers another evidence assessment, with the Lossless Evidence Memory keeping previously acquired evidence available throughout the process. The loop terminates once the residual is within the tolerance and no candidate remains undecided, or after at most three verification rounds.
blocks.zh: 所产生的反馈反馈给自愿核查组,由其进行额外的检查或测量,并根据需要修改答复。 每次随后提交都触发了另一次证据评估,无损失证据记忆保留了整个过程中以前获得的证据。 一旦剩余部分处于耐受性范围内,而且没有候选人仍未决定,或最多经过三轮核查,循环即告终止。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: Table 1 : Main results by task. Tasks are grouped into measurement, localization and measurement, detection, and diagnosis. (A) Medical VLMs with direct image input. (B) Methods sharing the Qwen3.8-27B backbone. (C) General VLMs evaluated with and without VERA. Scores are reported in %; Δ \Delta denotes the change in percentage points relative to direct input with the same backbone.
blocks.zh: 表1:按任务分列的主要结果。 任务分为计量、本地化和计量、检测和诊断。 (A) 具有直接图像输入的医学VLM。 (B)共享Quen3.8-27B骨干的方法. (C) 使用和不使用VERA评估的一般自愿终止措施。 分数以 % 表示;\\ Delta 表示百分比与直接输入同一主干部分相比的变化。

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate VERA on 11 tasks spanning CT, MRI, ultrasound, and whole-slide pathology. The tasks are grouped into four categories: measurement, localization and measurement, detection, and diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价VERA的11项任务 包括CT、核磁共振、超声波和全滑坡病理学 这些任务分为四类:计量、本地化和计量、检测和诊断。

blocks.en: Measurement. Four tasks evaluate quantitative measurements with the target structure or its location specified in the prompt. These include synthetic phantoms (20 cases), spleen and lung tumour CT from MSD [ 1 ] (15 cases each), and renal lesion CT from KiTS23 [ 11 ] (30 cases). The requested measurements include diameter, volume, and Hounsfield units. The renal lesion task also includes differentiation between cysts and solid tumours.
blocks.zh: 测量。 四项任务评价定量测量,以目标结构或即时指定的位置. 其中包括合成幽灵(20例)、MSD[1]的脾脏和肺肿瘤CT(每例15例)和KitS23[11]的肾脏损伤CT(30例)。 所要求的测量包括直径、体积和Hounsfield单元。 肾脏损伤的任务还包括囊肿和固体肿瘤的区别.

blocks.en: Localization and measurement. Four tasks require the VLM to search for and localize the target before performing quantitative measurement. These include renal search on KiTS23 [ 11 ] (20 cases), lung search on MSD [ 1 ] (20 cases), brain tumour MRI from BraTS/MSD [ 1 , 20 ] (100 cases), and echocardiography from CAMUS [ 17 ] (100 cases). Successful completion depends on both correct target localization and accurate measurement.
blocks.zh: 本地化和计量. 四项任务要求VLM在进行定量测量之前先搜索目标并将其定位. 其中包括对KitS23[11](20个病例)进行肾脏搜索,对MSD[1](20个病例)进行肺部搜索,来自BrATS/MSD的脑肿瘤核磁共振[1,20](100个病例),以及来自CAMUS的回波心电图[17](100个病例). 成功完成取决于正确的目标定位和准确的衡量。

blocks.en: Detection. The detection task targets all pulmonary nodules with a diameter of at least 3 mm in 69 held-out CT scans from LUNA16 [ 26 ] . The reference set contains 85 nodules accepted by at least three of four readers.
blocks.zh: 侦测 探测任务针对的是LUNA16型CT扫描器的69个封存CT中直径至少3毫米的所有肺结核[26]. 该参考集包含85个结核,至少四个读者中有三个接受。

blocks.en: Diagnosis. The two diagnosis tasks are multi-label classification of 18 chest CT findings on CT-RATE [ 9 ] (50 scans) and slide-level classification of sentinel lymph node metastasis on CAMELYON16 [ 6 ] (24 whole-slide images).
blocks.zh: 诊断. 两项诊断任务是对CT-RATE[9](50次扫描)上的18个胸腔CT发现进行多标签分类,对CAMELYON16[6](24张全滑图像)上的哨点淋巴结元数据进行幻灯片级分类.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. For measurement and localization-and-measurement tasks, a numerical prediction is counted as correct if its error falls within the predefined clinical tolerance for that quantity. Categorical predictions, such as cyst versus solid, are evaluated by exact agreement with the reference label. The score for each case is the proportion of correct predictions across the requested outputs. For LUNA16 [ 26 ] , we report nodule-level sensitivity for detections with confidence ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 . A prediction is matched to a reference nodule if the distance between their centers is within the reference nodule’s radius. For CT-RATE, we report macro-F1 across the 18 chest findings. For CAMELYON16, we report balanced accuracy for slide-level metastasis classification.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 对于测量和本地化及测量任务,如果数值预测的误差属于该数量预先确定的临床耐受性,则计为正确。 类预测,如囊泡对固态,由与参考标签的精确一致评价. 每个案例的得分是所要求产出正确预测的比例。 就LUNA16[26]而言,我们报告结核级别的敏感度,以便有把握地探测到 0.5\geq 0.5 (英语). 如果结核中心之间的距离在参考结核半径以内,则与参照结核相匹配。 对于CT-RATE,我们报告在18个胸口发现的宏F1. 对于CAMELYON 16,我们报告幻灯片级元数据分类的平衡准确性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: Backbones. We use Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 as the primary backbone, deployed locally with vLLM. Additional backbones include the open-source VLM Gemma 4 31B and four API-based models, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Kimi K3, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol. Each backbone is evaluated with direct image input and with VERA on the same cases ( Table 1 , bottom). Due to the API costs for three token-intensive tasks, we evaluate the four API-based models on smaller subsets: 40 LUNA16 scans, 60 brain tumour MRI cases, and 60 echocardiography cases.
blocks.zh: 后骨es. 我们使用Qune3.8-27B-FP8作为主骨干,在当地部署VLLM. 额外的骨干包括开源VLM Gemma 4 31B和四个基于API的型号,双子座3.5 Flash,Kimi K3,克劳德·奥普斯5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol. 每个主干部分都通过直接图像输入和VERA对相同案例进行评估(表1,底部)。 由于三个象征性密集任务的API成本,我们评价四个基于API的模型在较小的子集上:40个LUNA16扫描,60个脑肿瘤核磁共振病例,60个回声心电图病例.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare VERA with two groups of baselines using the same cases, prompts, and step budgets. Medical VLMs. We evaluate five medical VLMs with direct image input and no agent framework: MedGemma-1.5-4B [ 24 ] and MedGemma-27B [ 25 ] , Lingshu-32B [ 16 ] , Hulu-Med-32B [ 13 ] , and ClinFusion-32B [ 34 ] . Each model is evaluated using its supported input formats, including native 3D loading, labeled 2D slices, or frames. For models supporting multiple formats, we report the best result across those formats. Agent baselines. All three baselines use the same Qwen3.8-27B backbone as VERA. The zoom agent follows “thinking with images” [ 31 , 35 ] , supporting slice rendering, panning, and cropping without structured memory. VISTA [ 10 ] combines lossless visual memory with tools for retrieval, zooming, and quantitative readouts. MDAgents [ 15 ] is a multi-agent framework that rates the complexity of each case and assigns either a single clinician agent or a team of clinician agents, all reading the same images as the direct read.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们利用同样的案例、提示和步骤预算,将电子逆向拍卖与两组基线进行比较。 医用VLMs. 我们通过直接图像输入和无代理框架来评估5个医疗甚高频: MedGemma-1.5-4B [24] 和 MedGemma-27B [25], Lingshu-32B [16], Hulu-Med-32B [13], ClinFusion-32B [34]. 每个模型都使用其支持的输入格式进行评估,包括本地的3D加载,标签为2D切片,或帧. 对于支持多种格式的模式,我们报告这些格式的最佳结果。 代理基线。 这三个基线都使用与VERA相同的Quen3.8-27B骨干. 缩放剂遵循“用图像思考”[31,35],支持切片渲染、平整和没有结构内存的裁剪。 VISTA [10] 将无损失的视觉内存与检索,缩放和定量读取的工具结合起来. MDAgents [15]是一个多代理框架,它能对每个病例的复杂程度进行评分,并指派一个单一的临床医生代理或一组临床医生代理,全部读取与直接读取的图像相同.

blocks.en: 4.3 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.3 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2 : Ablation results on the Qwen3.8-27B backbone across four task categories. Small numbers indicate changes relative to the full method.
blocks.zh: 表2: Quen3.8-27B主干线在4个任务类别上的计算结果。 数字小表示相对于全方法的变化.

blocks.en: Comparison with medical VLMs. The five medical VLMs show varying performance across tasks. Lingshu-32B achieves the highest score on lung tumour measurement (80.0%), while ClinFusion-32B performs best on lung search (68.8%). MedGemma-27B leads on CAMELYON16 (81.2%), and Hulu-Med-32B achieves the highest CT-RATE score (48.0%). However, none of the five models detects pulmonary nodules, and their echocardiography scores do not exceed 27.5%. In comparison, VERA with the Qwen3.8-27B backbone surpasses all five medical VLMs on 7 of the 11 tasks. The gains are particularly clear in tasks requiring localization and measurement: VERA achieves 71.2% on renal search and 85.8% on brain tumour measurement, compared with the best medical VLM scores of 51.2% and 65.0%, respectively. VERA also achieves 28.2% on pulmonary nodule detection and 46.2% on echocardiography, where all five medical VLMs perform poorly.
blocks.zh: 与医学VLM比较. 5个医疗甚高频显示不同任务的业绩各不相同。 灵舒-32B在肺肿瘤测量上成绩最高(80.0%),而ClinFusion-32B在肺部搜索上表现最好(68.8%). MedGemma-27B领先于CAMELYON16(81.2%),而Hulu-Med-32B则实现了最高的CT-RATE得分(48.0%). 然而,五个模型中没有一个检测到肺结核,其回声心律分数不超过27.5%. 相比之下,VERA与Quen3.8-27B主干线在11项任务中的7项超过了所有5项医疗VLM. 在需要本地化和测量的任务中,收益特别明显:VERA在肾脏搜索方面达到71.2%,在脑肿瘤测量方面达到85.8%,而最佳医学VLM分数分别为51.2%和65.0%. VERA还实现了肺结核检测率为28.2%,回声心电图率为46.2%,所有5个医学VLM都表现不佳.

blocks.en: Comparison with agent baselines. Zoom agent and VISTA improve measurement through interactive visual inspection: VISTA raises spleen measurement from 63.3% to 90.0% and renal lesion measurement from 71.1% to 93.3%. Their localization gains are less consistent, and pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity does not exceed 14.1%. MDAgents improves diagnostic performance but provides limited measurement gains and detects no pulmonary nodules. VERA reaches 28.2% pulmonary nodule sensitivity, double the best agent baseline, and 71.2% on renal search versus 58.8% for VISTA and 60.0% for MDAgents. It also achieves the highest CT-RATE score (33.6%) among agent baselines and matches their best CAMELYON16 score (65.6%), supporting diagnostic evidence assessment within visual interaction.
blocks.zh: 与代理人基线的比较。 缩放剂和VISTA通过互动视觉检查改进测量:VISTA将脾脏测量从63.3%提高到90.0%,肾脏损伤测量从71.1%提高到93.3%。 它们的本地化收益不太一致,肺结核检测敏感性不超过14.1%。 MDAgents改进了诊断性能,但提供的测量收益有限,检测不到肺结核。 VERA的肺结核敏感度达到28.2%,是最佳剂基线的两倍,肾脏搜索率为71.2%,而VISTA为58.8%,MDAgent为60.0%。 它还在剂基线中实现了最高的CT-RATE分数(33.6%),并与其最佳的CAMELYON16分数(65.6%)相匹配,支持在视觉相互作用中进行诊断性证据评估.

blocks.en: Performance with stronger backbones. VERA improves performance across backbones, with particularly strong results on high-capability API-based VLMs, which frequently exceed 90% on measurement and localization tasks. GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 95.6% on lung tumour measurement, 87.5% on renal search, and 95.4% on brain tumour measurement, substantially outperforming Qwen3.8-27B+VERA on these tasks. Pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity increases from 6.2% to 60.0% with Claude Opus 5.5 and from 10.8% to 69.2% with GPT-6.1 Sol. These gains show that VERA enables more capable backbones to achieve substantially higher performance across medical imaging tasks. Gemma 4-31B shows less consistent gains.
blocks.zh: 性能更强的骨干。 VERA提高了各骨干部门的业绩,在基于API的高能力VLM上取得了特别强的成果,在测量和本地化任务上经常超过90%. GPT-6.1 常规 溶液在肺肿瘤测量上达到95.6%,在肾脏搜索上达到87.5%,在脑肿瘤测量上达到95.4%,在这些任务上,素效显著超过Qune3.8-27B+VERA. 肺结核检测灵敏度从6.2%增至60.0%,克劳德·奥普斯为5.5,GPT-6.1 Sol为10.8%增至69.2%。 这些成果表明,VERA能够使更有能力的骨干骨干在医疗成像任务中实现显著更高的性能. Gemma 4-31B显示的所得不尽一致.

blocks.en: 4.4 Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性结果

blocks.en:
Figure 3 presents three examples from CT, MRI, and ultrasound. In the CT case, direct image input leads to incorrect lesion localization and inaccurate size and density estimates. With VERA, the VLM locates the lesion, examines the corresponding slice and neighboring slices, and obtains HU measurements from the lesion region, producing results closer to the reference. In the MRI case, VERA locates the tumour and combines T1
intensity readouts with targeted FLAIR measurements to estimate
the core diameter and whole-tumour volume. For echocardiography, VERA identifies the correct end-systolic frame and measures the left ventricle across two views, yielding an ejection fraction of 39.1%, close to the reference value of 39.0%. Across these examples, VERA enables the VLM to move beyond fixed image input and obtain task-specific evidence through targeted visual inspection and measurement. Together, these cases illustrate how VERA turns visual interaction into task-directed evidence acquisition, enabling more accurate localization, measurement, and assessment across different imaging modalities.
blocks.zh:
图3提供了来自CT、核磁共振和超声波的三个实例。 在CT案中,直接图像输入会导致不正确的损伤局部化和不准确的大小和密度估计. 通过VERA,VLM定位损伤,检查相应的切片和相邻切片,从损伤区域获得HU测量结果,得出更接近参考的结果. 在核磁共振病例中,VERA定位肿瘤并结合T1
使用有针对性的FLAIR测量值进行强度读取以估算
核心直径和整个肿瘤体积。 对于回声心电学,VERA识别正确的端-静脉框架,并测量横跨两个视点的左侧通风,产生39.1%的弹出分数,接近39.0%的参考值. 在这些例子中,VERA使VLM能够超越固定的图像输入,并通过有针对性的视觉检查和测量获得特定任务的证据. 这些案例共同说明了VERA如何将视觉互动转化为任务导向的证据获取,从而能够更准确地定位、测量和评估不同成像模式。

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: We examine the individual and joint contributions of the Evidence Map and Evidence Verifier on the Qwen3.8-27B backbone in Table 2 . Removing the Evidence Verifier leads to substantial drops in quantitative measurement, including spleen (98.3% to 70.0%) and renal lesion (96.7% to 85.6%). Removing the Evidence Map has its largest impact on pulmonary nodule detection, where sensitivity drops from 28.2% to 14.1%, as well as lung search (40.0% to 31.2%). These results show that the two components address different aspects of medical image interpretation: assessing identified findings and tracking the progress of image inspection. Removing both components also disables Evidence-Guided Agentic Loop, leaving the VLM to rely on its initial assessment without feedback on the acquired evidence. Performance drops across all 11 tasks, with particularly large declines in spleen measurement ( − 28.3 -28.3 points), renal search ( − 16.2 -16.2 points), and pulmonary nodule detection ( − 15.3 -15.3 points). This demonstrates that the Evidence Map and Evidence Verifier work together to guide the agentic loop, connecting visual exploration with evidence assessment and subsequent inspection.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了表2中Quen3.8-27B主干线上的证据地图和证据验证人的个人和联合贡献。 证据核实器的删除导致数量测量大幅下降,包括脾脏(98.3%至70.0%)和肾脏损伤(96.7%至85.6%)。 删除证据地图对肺结核检测的影响最大,肺结核的敏感度从28.2%下降到14.1%,对肺部搜索的影响也最大(40.0%下降到31.2%)。 这些结果显示,这两个部分涉及医疗图像解释的不同方面:评估已查明的调查结果和跟踪图像检查的进展。 移除这两个组件也会禁用证据指导代理循环,使得VLM依赖其初步评估而无需反馈获得的证据. 性能在所有11项任务中下降,脾脏测量(−28.3-28.3分)、肾脏搜索(−16.2-16.2分)和肺结核检测(−15.3-15.3分)的下降尤为严重。 这表明,证据地图和证据验证人合作指导代理环路,将视觉勘探与证据评估和随后的检查联系起来。

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation has several limitations. First, the four API-based VLMs were evaluated on smaller subsets for three token-intensive tasks due to API costs, limiting the scope of cross-backbone comparisons. Second, since our evaluation relies on public datasets, we cannot rule out potential overlap between these datasets and the training data of proprietary VLMs. Third, VERA’s performance remains dependent on the VLM’s ability to interpret medical images and execute tool calls reliably. Limitations in these capabilities may adversely affect VERA’s performance across medical imaging tasks. Finally, our evaluation is based on public datasets and does not include validation in real-world clinical environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价有几个局限性。 首先,由于API的成本,四个基于API的VLM在三个符号密集型任务的较小子集上得到了评价,限制了交叉背骨比较的范围. 第二,由于我们的评估依赖于公共数据集,我们不能排除这些数据集与专有甚高压材料培训数据之间可能存在的重叠。 第三,VERA的性能仍然取决于VLM可靠地解释医疗影像和执行工具呼叫的能力. 这些能力的局限性可能会对VERA在医疗成像任务方面的表现产生不利影响。 最后,我们的评价是基于公共数据集,不包括在现实世界临床环境中的验证。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced VERA, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. By preserving acquired observations and assessing the evidence supporting identified findings, VERA guides VLMs through iterative visual exploration, verification, and targeted re-examination. Experiments across 11 tasks and 4 imaging modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over direct image input, spanning measurement, localization, detection, and diagnosis. These improvements are also observed with strong API-based VLMs, which achieve substantially higher performance when equipped with VERA. Our findings highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new direction for advancing general VLMs in medical imaging.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了VERA,一种医疗视觉控制装置,它为普通的VLM配备了交互式视觉工具和系统诊断证据管理. 通过保留已获得的观察和评估支持已查明结论的证据,VERA通过迭代视觉探索、核查和有针对性地重新审查,为VLM提供指导。 跨越11项任务和4个成像模式的实验表明,在直接图像输入、跨度测量、本地化、检测和诊断方面,不断改进。 这些改进也以强大的API为基础的VLM来观测,在装备VERA时能实现显著更高的性能. 我们的研究结果突出了视觉利用的潜力,认为这是在医学成像方面推进一般甚高强度材料的新方向。
